notes.text: De Beer profile resampled from 360 raw points to 90 bins of 0.20 m.

De Beer Stage 1 (homogeneous values) implemented as q_h = q_c (identity); the diameter scale-effect is applied through the gradient limits in Stages 2 and 3. The full BGGG [4] homogeneous-conversion equations are not in the public source set.
Layer 4 excluded from shaft friction (layer-mean q_c = 0.92 MPa < 1 MPa).
Layer 5 excluded from shaft friction (layer-mean q_c = 0.94 MPa < 1 MPa).
